fixture_units: finite synthetic populations only; no campaign rows

matrix.claim_under_attack: large denominator coefficient of variation implies a biased conditional optimum
matrix.fixture: identical denominator multiset, balanced versus denominator-correlated residuals; fixed conditional teacher
matrix.counterexample_acceptance: CV exceeds 2 in both populations; normalized and pooled optima coincide in balanced population, differ by more than 0.5 after distillation in correlated population
matrix.actor_acceptance: derive separate supervised and teacher coefficient measures conditional on causal inputs; measure signed weighted residual or gradient differences at a common checkpoint, not CV alone; isolate coefficient changes from normalization and membership
matrix.actor_rejection: CV or a loss-value shift alone is presented as optimum bias or Global WP gain
matrix.limitations: free conditional prediction functions and a deterministic teacher; not actual trainer loss or constrained GRU fitting

matrix.claim_under_attack: a perfect target-functional fit on complete observed fragments identifies the generating stopping law
matrix.fixture: enumerate three-step signed paths and two classes; class/coverage selects offset-tail paths; fixed third-step displacement versus first unit-barrier hit
matrix.counterexample_acceptance: two stopping laws fit every complete case exactly; they disagree on half the full population; unknown path mass is explicitly nonzero; transported first-hit MSE exceeds 1
matrix.actor_acceptance: frozen law/transform parameters; coverage by class and sequence position; unknown transitions never imputed as no-event; matched coverage comparisons and transport; nonidentification stated when competing laws agree
matrix.actor_rejection: complete-case fit reported as generator identification, or class/censoring selection ignored
matrix.limitations: finite invented laws; does not refute any particular real-label stopping family

matrix.claim_under_attack: large intervention response reveals missing useful information, or zero response proves history is useless
matrix.fixture: redundant history on deterministic support, an off-support-sensitive predictor, and independent informative history ignored by another predictor
matrix.counterexample_acceptance: redundant-history OOD response exceeds 10 while conditional Bayes-risk improvement is zero; ignored informative history has zero response yet feasible risk reduction exceeds 1
matrix.actor_acceptance: identity control and actual prediction validity; distinguish functional sensitivity, conditional information and exploitable model deficit; quantify intervention support and pair current/history controls; improve heldout target loss/Global WP with a feasible causal predictor before asserting missed information
matrix.actor_rejection: response magnitude alone is equated with conditional information or deployable forecast gain
matrix.limitations: finite binary predictor fixtures; no strong-GRU checkpoint inspected

matrix.claim_under_attack: an apparent representation or horizon deficit is intrinsic to the learned predictor
matrix.fixture: proposed only: equivalent causal streams under sequence reordering and chunk repartition, with exact reset and every-row update contract
matrix.actor_acceptance: freeze one checkpoint and input bytes; reset at seq_ix transitions; compare original versus sequence-order permutation, pause/replay, and chunk partitions; predictions match within declared dtype tolerance and all required outputs are finite
matrix.actor_rejection: unexplained representation-dependent predictions on identical causal input histories
matrix.limitations: untested fourth proposal; reviewer cannot approve its own candidate or infer WP gain

global_gate.selection: need_prediction AND is_scored, pooled across sequences
global_gate.weights: absolute target after target/prediction clipping to [-2,2]
global_gate.deployment: no future inputs, targets or is_scored in inference; state reset on sequence transition; every input row updates state
global_gate.evidence: synthetic counterexamples falsify implications only; real frozen actor results require independent controller-assigned testing
